attachments.content: A video of me soldering a ATXMEGA32A4U-AU microcontroller in a QFN-44 package to the Nonolith Labs CEE PCB using solderpaste and a hotplate set to 215C.

object.content: It turns out that I did manage to record a video of me soldering the uC on the CEE board last night. If you pay attention to other parts of the board you can see the flux burning off that I used to hand solder the other parts. I also cleaned the chip up with some desoldering braid afterwards to get rid of the huge short I created on the nearest side to the camera.
